description: Report a problem with THIS MCP server (ZAP-Hosting / ZapX) to its developers. Use it only after a real problem with these tools: kind=bug when a tool failed or returned something wrong although the input looked right; kind=missing_capability when the user asked for something no tool here can do; kind=unclear_tool_description when a tool's description or parameters misled you; kind=improvement for a concrete suggestion that would have made the task easier. Do NOT use it for the user's own support requests (problems with their server, billing, orders): the user opens a support ticket for those. Never include passwords, tokens, API keys, file contents, personal data or other secrets in summary, details or exampleArgs. Nothing is changed on any service. The result only confirms that the report was received; do not tell the user it was fixed.

details.description: What you tried, what you expected and what happened (error text). No secrets or file contents.

exampleArgs.description: Optional arguments of the failing call, without secrets.

relatedTool.description: Name of the tool the report is about, if any (e.g. get_gameserver).

summary.description: One sentence: what went wrong or what is missing.

name: report_mcp_feedback
title: Send Feedback About This Connector
